name: Smosh Mouth
description: Join Shayne Topp (short), Amanda Lehan-Canto (tall), and a rotating Smosh friend as we discuss what’s on our minds, what we’ve found on the internet, and other dumb ideas we’re cooking up.

videos.title: Bonus: Live from VidCon 2019!
videos.overview: This live SmoshCast was recorded at VidCon 2019. Tune in for Smosh Summer Games ’19 trash talk, Buca di Beppo story time, and our most memorable VidCon moments.

videos.title: Why Sarah is Leaving Smosh (*not clickbait*) (*emotional*)
videos.overview: This isn’t clickbait, we swear! Everyone’s favorite Lisa Frank Trapper Keeper personified— Sarah Whittle, is saying farewell to Smosh! In this special episode of the SmoshCast, Sarah opens up to Ian, Courtney, and Shayne about why she’s leaving us (for real this time) and shares some of her favorite Smosh memories.

videos.title: Smosh Mouth Live
videos.overview: Join Shayne Topp (short), Amanda Lehan-Canto (tall) LIVE IN PERSON at Dynasty Typewriter, here in LA, as our hosts help solve our audience and special guests' problems!

videos.title: HOW SMOSH BEAT DEFY
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and Shayne SPILL THE TEA on Defy Media and break down how we all lost our jobs, had no idea if Smosh would ever come back, and how two tall men came in to save the day.

videos.title: WE NEED TO TALK ABOUT ANTHONY AND CELERY JUICE
videos.overview: Ian, Shayne, and Olivia sit down to chat about why you should stop asking about where Anthony is, Shayne’s matchmaking skills and sh*tting on people’s lawns.

videos.title: Courtney's Sexuality & How Ian Handles The Haters
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and Damien discuss Ian’s bad Instagram game, Lilly Singh’s recent coming out post and Courtney’s own journey with discovering her sexuality, and the best ways to deal with negative comments online.

videos.title: Michael Jackson and the Danger of Fandoms
videos.overview: Ian, Keith, and Noah discuss whether or not Michael Jackson is innocent, why Ian wants you to hold him accountable for his actions, and why Noah keeps ruining cars.

videos.title: MatPat - OUR FIRST GUEST!!!
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and first guest ever (!) MatPat talk all things Defy, why “Black Smosh” almost happened, the toxicity of the internet, and their opinions on live-action Aladdin.

videos.title: Why Shayne Won't Talk Nerdy On A First Date
videos.overview: Ian is joined by Shayne and Smosh’s very own Meme Queen Sarah Whittle to chat about Shayne’s traumatic toothache experience, their opinions on Jordan Peele’s “Us,“ and how much of themselves they reveal on a first date.

videos.title: The Return of Smosh Games
videos.overview: Mari and Lasercorn join Ian to talk about the triumphant return of Smosh Games, Mari's cucumber obsession, and why Lasercorn is afraid to open Instagram in front of his wife.

videos.title: The Time Our Director Was (Almost) Attacked
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and Smosh's favorite director, Ryan Todd spill the tea on the early days of Smosh, that time they almost got attacked on set, and why Ryan is the most detrimental part of Smosh— according to Courtney.

videos.title: Rhett & Link, Saviors of SMOSH!
videos.overview: Ian, joined by Damien and Rhett & Link, talk about what it’s really like working at the Mythical/Smosh offices, those viral cliff-jumping walruses, and what Link's dad loves to get up to on the beach.

videos.title: Tinder For Hot Dogs
videos.overview: Shayne and Smosh’s long-time Staff Writer Monica Vasandani join Ian on this week’s SmoshCast to talk about Jessy Taylor’s infamous Insta breakdown, that one time Ian got racially profiled, and the Smosh sketch Shayne REALLY wants to get green-lit.

videos.title: Is Joven Coming Back To Smosh Games?
videos.overview: Courtney hosts this week’s podcast with special guests Joven & Matt Raub to answer the question you’ve ALL been asking— Is Joven coming back to Smosh Games?

videos.title: Ian & The Slow Mo Guys
videos.overview: Ian and The Slow Mo Guys take a break from YouTube’s Creator Summit to chat about all things fart-related, questionably useful hangover cures, and the funny reason why Ian won't use stairs.

videos.title: ProJared Drama & Ian Dating Courtney's Sister?
videos.overview: On this week’s SmoshCast, Ian, Shayne and Courtney recap their thoughts on Detective Pikachu, dive in to the ProJared and h3h3 drama, and talk about Ian being set up with Courtney’s sister.

videos.title: WHY WE BROKE UP w/ Ian & His Ex-Girlfriend Pamela Horton
videos.overview: Mari sits down with Ian and his ex-girlfriend Pamela Horton as they open up about their relationship, the reasons it ended, and how it’s still possible to be friends.

videos.title: EVERYONE IS CANCELLED (James Charles, Tfue, Jake Paul)
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and Shayne kick off Gemini season by breaking down all of the current YouTuber drama, from Tati & James Charles to Cody Ko & Jake Paul, and discuss why cancelling someone in the midst of a scandal may not be the best idea.

videos.title: Coming Out, Dating & First Kisses (PRIDE MONTH SPECIAL)
videos.overview: Courtney, Staff Writer Monica Vasandani, and MemeLord Tommy Bowe kick off Pride Month by having an open conversation about what coming out was like for them, finding their place in the LGBTQ+ community, and their awkwardly sweet first kisses.

videos.title: Body Dysmorphia & Why Damien Hates Dating
videos.overview: Ian, Shayne, and Damien open up about their insecurities, discuss Damien’s dating life (or lack thereof), and breakdown Ian’s infamous 2 Truths, 1 Lie cheating disaster.

videos.title: Olivia’s Bald Spot & How Defy Forced Us To Be Friends
videos.overview: On this week’s SmoshCast, Courtney, Olivia, and Mari open up about their struggles with stress and the pressure of being perfect, feeling replaceable on Smosh, and being pitted against each other at Defy.

videos.title: How To Make The First Move & Not Be A Creep (Smosh Advice)
videos.overview: You asked for #SmoshAdvice on Twitter and Ian, Shayne, and Courtney are here to help! From staying motivated in life to the best place to hide a body, we’re dedicating this SmoshCast to answering your most pressing questions.

videos.title: Side Yard Hookups and The Case Of The Mystery Pooper
videos.overview: Courtney, Shayne, and Damien break down all of the pros and cons of having roommates— from sketchy side yard hookups, to living with “dirty hippies.” Shayne talks about what it was like living in Damien’s garage and Courtney opens up about her curious case of the Mystery Pooper.

videos.title: Being A Woman In The Smosh Boys Club
videos.overview: Ian, Courtney, and Sarah recap their 4th of July adventures, open up about the struggle of being a woman on the Smosh team, and talk about being literally shook by the recent Southern California earthquakes.

videos.title: Spilling The Tea on Smosh Summer Games
videos.overview: In case you missed it, Smosh Summer Games is BACK! Ian, Matt, and Mari talk all things Smosh Summer Games: Apocalypse, from Joven’s weirdest punishment idea yet to Ian’s conspiracy theory about the on-set caterers.

videos.title: Does Wes Miss Being At Smosh?
videos.overview: It’s Wes’ first time… on the SmoshCast! Courtney, Shayne, and Wes walk down Smosh Summer Games memory lane and make their predictions for how this year’s games will play out. Shayne pitches his big follow up idea to Tinder For Hot Dogs and we find out if Wes truly misses being at Smosh everyday.

videos.title: How Defy Took Advantage Of Our Fans
videos.overview: Ian, Joven, and Lasercorn take a break from their apocalyptic battle and chat about the worst Smosh Summer Games punishments of all time, that one time Ian was banned from meeting Barack Obama, and the awful business call Defy made that took advantage of our fans.

videos.title: The Desk That Ruined Our Friendship
videos.overview: Mushroom Clout’s Courtney, Keith, and Noah catch up with each other in the desert to talk about Forensic Files, why Keith started saying “no” to things, and the dramatic story of how a desk almost ended Courtney and Keith’s friendship before it even started.

videos.title: Leaks, Cheating, and Other Summer Games Secrets
videos.overview:
*MAJOR SPOILERS FOR SMOSH SUMMER GAMES: APOCALYPSE*

Nine of us gathered into a conference room to recap some of the most iconic moments of this year’s Games— from Keith leaking Summer Games in the worst way, to the shameless cheating moments of this season.

videos.title: The Grandfathers Of YouTube w/ Ryan Higa
videos.overview: Ian and Mari sat down with Ryan Higa before VidCon to talk about what it’s like keeping a YouTube channel alive for almost fifteen years, the pressure of having to be the representative of your culture in media, and whether or not Ian & Ryan they regret the cringey movies they made.

videos.title: Should Courtney Get Hypnotized? w/ Podcast But Outside
videos.overview: Ian and Courtney invite Podcast But Outside co-hosts Andrew Michaan & Cole Hersch indoors to talk about Cole’s time working as a writer for Smosh during the Defy era, conquering your fears via hypnotism, and the crazy way Cole rescued his cat.

videos.title: So Random! Reunion Special w/ Matthew Scott Montgomery and Allisyn Ashley Arm
videos.overview: Shayne and Damien reunite with So Random! co-stars Matthew Scott Montgomery and Allisyn Ashley Arm to dish on the origin of Dark Damien, bad makeup artists, and the reality of what it’s really like to be a Disney star.

videos.title: Ian (Finally) Goes To Therapy
videos.overview: On today’s episode, Ian, Shayne, and Courtney discuss Shayne’s final college classes, why Courtney enjoyed writing fan fiction as a kid, and Ian opens up about finally going to therapy.

videos.title: Our Top 5 Favorite Smosh Videos of All Time

videos.title: Does Keith Resent Ian?
